name: Behir
summary: A serpentine monstrosity that constricts prey and breathes lightning.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The behir makes one Bite attack and uses Constrict.

actions.name: Constrict

save.targets: one Large or smaller creature the behir can see within 5 feet

actions.onFailure: The target has the Grappled condition (escape {dc=16}), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

bonusActions.name: Swallow

save.targets: one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the behir (the behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time)

bonusActions.onFailure:
The behir swallows the target, which is no longer Grappled. While swallowed, a creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and takes {dmg:6d6:acid} at the start of each of the behir's turns.

If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a {dc:wis} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the behir and has the Prone condition. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.
